recipes.name: WHOLE CHICKEN
ingredients: baking powder (optional, for extra crispy skin)
freshly ground black pepper, to taste
2 tbsp bacon fat (optional but highly recommended)
1 small bunch fresh parsley, rinsed and dried
salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Spatchcock the chicken using kitchen shears. Cut along both sides of the chicken’s spine and remove it (save for stock if desired). Snip the breastbone slightly and press down to flatten the chicken. - 4 1 lbs whole chicken
Tuck wing tips underneath the breasts to prevent burning. - 4 1 lbs whole chicken

Place the chicken on a foil-lined baking sheet. Rub all over with a generous amount of kosher salt (optional: mix with a teaspoon of baking powder for ezra crispiness). - 4 1 lbs whole chicken - kosher salt to taste - baking powder (optional for extra crispy skin)

Lay rosemary and thyme sprigs on top, then refrigerate uncovered for 24 hours. This step deepens the flavor and dries out the skin for extra crispiness. - 4 1 lbs whole chicken - 3 sprigs fresh rosemary - 3 sprigs fresh thyme

In a small bowl, combine softened butter, chopped rosemary, and thyme. Add bacon fat for an extra layer of flavor if you’re feeling fancy. Mix until it’s a smooth paste. - 3 tbsp softened salted butter - 3 sprigs fresh rosemary - 3 sprigs fresh thyme - 2 tbsp bacon fat (optional but highly recommended)

Gently loosen the skin of the chicken breast and thighs by carefully sliding your fingers underneath. Spread the herb butter mixture underneath the skin, ensuring an even layer for maximum flavor. Rub any remaining butter mixture on the outside of the skin. - 4 1 lbs whole chicken
Brush off excess salt, then season the chicken with a few twists of freshly-ground black pepper. - 4 1 lbs whole chicken - freshly ground black pepper to taste
Roast the chicken for about 45 minutes or until it reaches 155-165˚ F in the breasts and 175-185˚ F in the thighs and drumsticks. - 4 1 lbs whole chicken
While the chicken roasts, finely chop parsley and add to a small bowl. - 1 small bunch fresh parsley rinsed and dried

Mince or crush garlic, zest a lemon (using a microplane), and add the lemon zest and juice to the parsley. Season with salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil. Whisk until combined. - 3 cloves garlic - 1 lemon zest and juice - salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste - 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest, uncovered, for 10 minutes. - 4 1 lbs whole chicken

Slice the chicken into individual portions: separate thighs, drumsticks, wings, and halve the breasts. Arrange on a serving platter and top with gremolata or serve it on the side. - 4 1 lbs whole chicken - For the Gremolata
